people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: When I arrive, I will send whoever you approve with letters to carry your gracious gift to Jerusalem.
translations.bsb: Then, on my arrival, I will send letters with those you recommend to carry your gift to Jerusalem.
translations.kjv: And when I come, whomsoever ye shall approve by your letters, them will I send to bring your liberality unto Jerusalem.
translations.asv: And when I arrive, whomsoever ye shall approve, them will I send with letters to carry your bounty unto Jerusalem:
